title: Validating legislation for parliamentary spending
content:
19 October 2006

Validating legislation for parliamentary spending

  • Michael Cullen
Finance

Legislation is necessary to validate expenses incurred in breach of section 4 of the Public Finance Act 1989.

The only legal remedy for such a breach is for the expenses to be validated by an Act of Parliament.

  • A summary of Treasury advice to Finance Minister Dr Michael Cullen on why validating legislation is necessary is available here
  • The Cabinet paper detailing that advice is available here
  • The text of the Appropriation (Parliamentary Expenditure Validation) Bill currently being debated in the House can be viewed here
